subjects.113: post pregnant woman, as labelled by the CMU database

walk.segmentation: authored interval selected by source kinematics; not an original CMU subclip label

cycleSelection.method: minimum RMS limb-direction recurrence plus 300 degrees per metre of hip-height difference

standToSit.segmentation: authored interval selected by source kinematics; not an original CMU subclip label

sitToLie.segmentation: authored interval selected by source kinematics; not an original CMU subclip label

lieToSit.segmentation: authored interval selected by source kinematics; not an original CMU subclip label

sitToStand.segmentation: authored interval selected by source kinematics; not an original CMU subclip label

wave.segmentation: authored interval selected by source kinematics; not an original CMU subclip label

reconstruction.jointRotation: parent R * C * motion R * inverse C
reconstruction.handedness: reflect X once; rotations S R S
reconstruction.rootHeight: dimensionless hip height relative to source standing reference
reconstruction.limbs: direction and complete orientation tracks retargeted to R2 fixed segment lengths; twist is retained
reconstruction.spine: measured lumbar, thoracic and cervical rotations distributed over R2 source segments

limitations: Different people from the static R2 atlas; retargeting is not subject-specific motion capture.
No measured muscle, fat, skin displacement, compression or patellar tracking.
Terminal thumb and toe axes are skeletal proxies, not independently captured detailed tissue.
Starts, stops, path turns, contact fitting and segmentwise spine allocation are engineering adaptations.
No capture-backed source is installed for salute, loaded carrying or pushing.
